title: Voting Rights Act of 1965 — Statute profile
subject: Voting Rights Act of 1965
summary: Voting Rights Act of 1965 is a statute of United States enacted in 1965, in the area of voting rights. Banned racial discrimination in voting, including literacy tests. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 89-110.
key_points: Core effect: Banned racial discrimination in voting, including literacy tests.
Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
